newsitem.title: USA: Premier Bancshares sets first qtly div $0.08.
newsitem.headline: Premier Bancshares sets first qtly div $0.08.

text.p: Premier Bancshares Inc said Friday it declared its first regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share, payable May 22, 1997, to stockholders of record on May 8, 1997.
The company said in a release that it previously paid annual dividends rather than regular quarterly dividends.
On an annualized basis, the dividend represents a seven percent increase over the dividend paid for the previous year, the company said.
It added that the decision to pay on a quarterly basis was based on the company's "dramatic growth and positive earnings trend."
